## LXG-05 Reporting
Weekly (Mondays 08:00 UK) summary email + refreshes n8n-owned rows on the **Summary** tab.
Lead counts come from the Leads tab; emails sent / campaign status come from Instantly (if reachable — the report still sends if not).
Change frequency: edit the schedule node. Recipient: env `ALERT_EMAIL_TO` (or `REPORT_EMAIL_TO` if set).
